content:
MSU Procurement Policies and Procedures (2005) — 1.5.3 Report to the Maryland Board of Public Works:

Source: https://articulateusercontent.com/rise/courses/dr1x0wltGUgaTDQoS3qhL4PZTBSM_JJf/E9XdQ7FTUQWXpvpN.pdf
Attachment in the ORA eTraining module 'Purchasing with Purpose'. Full 118-page policy.

1.5.3 Report to the Maryland Board of Public Works:
Morgan State University shall, by September 30th of each year,
submit to the Board of Public Works an annual summary report of the
University’s procurement activities pertaining to contracts, renewals
or modifications covered by Section 1.5.2 above.
BPW Approval 9/21/2005 112
